submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires retrospectively on the token that completes a conventional multi-word proper name (country, court, league, newspaper, legislative body, event, agency, or initialism) when it directly continues the name's standard capitalized first half, e.g. States after United, Court after Supreme, Ireland after Northern, League after Major, Times after New York, Commons after House of, Series after World, Works after Public. The same head noun with a wrong modifier, in lowercase, or in a novel capitalized bigram does not activate it.
